channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Watch: Heartfelt song at Netanel Shakron's funeral
item.description: Crowds sing mournful, moving song at funeral of terror victim Netanel Shakron, who was murdered hours before Yom Kippur at the Ein Riya spring.

item.title: Chaos on the East Coast: Technical malfunction grounds thousands of flights
item.description:
A major malfunction in the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) communications systems is causing widespread disruptions to aircraft traffic on the East Coast.
Flights at airports in New York, New Jersey and Philadelphia were delayed or grounded, and thousands of flights across the US were affected. The outage was reportedly caused by a damaged fiber-optic cable in New Jersey.

item.title: Chilling: Terror victim's son recites first 'Kaddish' at his father's funeral
item.description: Yoav, eldest son of terror victim Netanel Shakron, recites 'Kaddish' at his father's funeral, a day after his father was killed in a terror attack hours before Yom Kippur.

item.title: Watch live: Netanel Shakron laid to rest after deadly Binyamin terror attack
item.description: Netanel Shakron, father of six murdered at Ein Riya spring, is laid to rest in Alei Zahav.

item.title: Polish army begins air operations in response to Russian attacks in Ukraine
item.description:
The Polish army announced that it has begun air operations in response to Russian attacks in Ukraine.
According to the Polish statement, the purpose of the activity is to ensure airspace security.

item.title: US media pushes back against Trump boycott
item.description: Following the White House’s decision to bar three news organizations from entering, other media outlets have suspended the press pool that accompanies the President wherever he goes.

item.title: Mystery blasts rock Syrian military sites
item.description: Three blasts hit weapons depots and military sites in less than two weeks, killing Syrian soldiers and prompting an investigation into possible Israeli involvement.

item.title: Demography is the greatest political force in European elections
item.description: Hatred of Jews, anti-capitalism, Islamism, and contempt for freedom will be the pillars of the European woke capitals. When they push the Jews out and allow countless Mulims in, this is what they get. Opinion.

item.title: Sa'ar: Miliband touts 'strong values' but won't condemn deadly terror attack
item.description:
Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar criticized his British counterpart Ed Miliband after Miliband posted a video touting his "strong values" even though he did not condemn the murder of an Israeli civilian in a terrorist attack in Binyamin on Sunday.
"We didn’t hear the part where you condemn the Palestinian murderer who killed a Jewish father in front of his son yesterday, on the eve of Yom Kippur," Sa'ar responded.
“Strong values"? he asked.

item.title: Report: Trump Admin. floats $5 billion to rehabilitate Gulf energy facilities
item.description: The Trump administration is proposing to allocate $5 billion to establish an investment fund to rehabilitate energy facilities in the Gulf, the Wall Street Journal reported.

item.title: Why Is Tehran terrified of French verbs?
item.description: On the same day Iran warned of US missile strikes, it shut down a French language institute. Here’s the sinister reason why-and why Europe can no longer play neutral. Opinion.

item.title: Hamas bomb hits IDF vehicle, Israel strikes back
item.description: Hamas plants explosive device that hits IDF engineering vehicle near Yellow Line; IDF strikes terrorist infrastructure, slamming 'blatant ceasefire violation.'

item.title: Report: UK prepared to support Saudi Arabia against the Houthis
item.description: The British Prime Minister is inclined to provide the Saudi military with operational support in order to deal with the Houthis and will work to convince other countries to help repel the rebels in Yemen, Bloomberg reported.

item.title: Demand to disqualify Ra’am: Bereaved families petition against Justice Sohlberg
item.description: The Choosing Life Forum is asking the Supreme Court to allow its representatives to be present in the hearing room during deliberations on the request they submitted to the Central Elections Committee to disqualify the Ra’am party.

item.title: Watch: Thousands gather for Ne’ila prayers in heart of Tel Aviv
item.description: Rosh Yehudi draws thousands to Meir Park for the closing prayers of Yom Kippur, with worshipers gathering throughout the day.

item.title: Qatar rejects report it funded Hamas
item.description:
Qatar strongly rejected the claims that it funded Hamas, claiming that the New Yorker investigation was based on false information and recycled and forged documents, which it said were part of an anti-Qatari campaign.
The Qatari Information Office statement claimed that elements on the far-right in Israel were behind the distribution of the documents. Doha also emphasized: "Nothing was transferred to Gaza without Israeli approval, whether it was financial aid or essential goods."

item.title: IDF foils imminent terror attack in Judea and Samaria
item.description: Duvdevan soldiers arrest two terrorists planning an immediate attack as IDF forces uncover weapons, explosives materials and a weapons-manufacturing lathe during Yom Kippur operations.

item.title: Watch: Yeshiva students end Yom Kippur with song and dance
item.description: Students in Acre and Sderot yeshivas mark the end of the holiest day of the Jewish year with singing, dancing and prayers for mercy.

item.title: Hundreds of Jews pray on Temple Mount on Yom Kippur
item.description: A full 654 Jewish ascents recorded as worshipers pray for hours with police-approved prayer books; National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir joins Mincha service ahead of the fast.

item.title: IED explodes on an engineering vehicle in the northern Gaza Strip, no casualties
item.description: An explosive device exploded a short while ago on an IDF engineering vehicle operating in the northern Gaza Strip. There were no casualties.

item.title: Three years later: Hostages Square gathers again in prayer
item.description: Nearly three years after October 7, Israelis return to Hostages Square for a prayer of gratitude, remembrance and unity.

item.title: IDF tracker fired at terrorist, saving victim's son
item.description: Investigation reveals terrorist returned to Ein Riya spring on eve of Yom Kippur and murdered father of six; IDF tracker’s gunfire prevented him from continuing the attack.

item.title: Shooting outside Ontario synagogue on Yom Kippur
item.description: Police officer critically wounded after gunman opens fire outside Canadian synagogue during Kol Nidre services.

item.title: Report: Trump administration to announce sanctions on Hague tribunal
item.description:
The US administration plans to soon announce sanctions it will impose on the International Criminal Court in The Hague, the Washington Post reported.
In the shadow of the ongoing tension between the administration and the court, Washington would like the court to remove the international arrest warrants against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, and to cease investigating the American military in the war in Afghanistan.

item.title: Report: Trump halted strike against Houthis
item.description: According to the report, the US President deliberated for approximately two weeks, instructed the Pentagon to prepare for airstrikes in Yemen - and yesterday decided to halt the move.

item.title: Gmar Chatima Tova!
item.description:
Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Yom Kippur in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Monday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Yom Kippur at 19:14 Jerusalem time.
Gmar Chatima Tova!

item.title: UEFA rejects Ireland request to keep Israel out of future draws
item.description:
UEFA rejects Ireland’s request to avoid future matchups with Israel, citing its case-by-case policy and the lack of a direct conflict between the countries.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Yom Kippur in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
